## Example Location-specific features

Direct assignment of values to specific properties

- Distance to Coast
- Distance to Water (lakes, rivers, etc.)
- Flood zone determination
- Roof Geometry & area
- Roof Damage
- Tree Overhang
- Attractive Nuisances
  - Swimming Pools
  - Trampolines

:::{.notes }
As opposed to territories that summarize the area the home is in, location-specific features are unique to the property.

If you go to Insurtech Connect in Las Vegas, you walk by dozens vendors in this space
:::
